title: Choo-choo train, Claude Haiku as the agent (purple Skippy's v1 setup)
model: Claude Haiku 5.5 in purple Skippy's place: the same Claude Code agent, instructions, folder, runtime and one-line request as v1, context capped at 138K. About $1.15 of API use
verdict: The fullest scene: a locomotive with cab, dome, bell, cowcatcher and a big smoke plume, a coal tender, coaches with rows of windows and a caboose with a cupola, all on the track, a raised platform, a brick-and-wood station house, a pond and trees. The coaches run together into one long body. Like-for-like with purple Skippy's v1 (only the model differs), it is clearly better, and three times faster.
